flagged.reason: The 1852 page prints the headword in capitals (ДРЕКАВАЦ) and the 1818 OCR reads Древавац; the sentence-case form is a normalisation of the 1852 headword, not a letter-for-letter print.

grade_rationale.text: Karadžić’s 1818 Serbian dictionary records the drekavac as a supposed four-footed animal that screams in the night like a goat being carried off.
The 1852 edition repeats the article; both editions are Karadžić’s and count as one source by one 19th-century compiler.
Every surviving clause rests on this one dictionary article, and the only people is the Serbs, fixed by the dictionary being a Serbian dictionary.
